description.value: Divino Estate Winery is a 100% estate winery on a 40-acre Cobble Hill vineyard, tracing its roots to owner-winemaker Joe Busnardo's original Oliver, BC operation in the early 1980s before relocating to the Cowichan Valley in 1996. The winery produces Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Pinot Grigio, Trebbiano, and a rotating cast of limited-release and late-harvest wines entirely from estate-grown fruit, with some rare old vintages only available on-site. Situated just off the Island Highway at the Cowichan Bay Road exit, it sits conveniently between Victoria and Nanaimo for cyclists riding the Vancouver Crossing Loop.
